name: Harness Degradation dataset v7 (real commits)
layout: dataset-directory-layout.md: positive/<visibility>/<introduced|preexisting>/<type>/, negative/<visibility>/<type>/; positive cells hold 1 sample, negative cells 2
imported_samples: V3-47 (postgresql) and V3-48 (binutils-gas) come from HarnessDegradation-MiniDataset-v5: real-commit, maintainer-fix samples whose experiment evidence (build and run logs) is in verification/. On 2026-11-03 both were re-checked against upstream git (mainline, M^1, diff, patch-id, source tree at M, harness at the pinned OSS-Fuzz revision) and brought to the layout of the other samples. All other samples were collected with collection_tools/.

extension_samples.note: Four directories kept outside cases/, none counted in size, distribution, cells, samples, canonical_map.csv or review/. Two are extra samples (status 'extension': V3-13 fmt, V3-49 zstd). The other two (status 'replaced') are the previous V3-12 and V3-33, replaced on 2026-11-09 by new samples (nlohmann-json, zstd) and moved here; their directory names carry a suffix for the reason (-CompileError: the old inih V3-12 failed to compile; -HarnessBroken: the old zlib V3-33 harness was broken). The ids V3-12, V3-13 and V3-33 are each used both here and in cases/: tell them apart by directory name.

conventions.type_assignment: labels follow the type definitions of dataset-distribution.md: api = public symbol signature/semantics/new mandatory call of an API the harness calls; configuration = compile-time macros, runtime flags/options, build switches; input_format = accepted input format/syntax/encoding/magic; state = internal state, globals, reset/reuse contracts; lifecycle = init/teardown/creation order/ownership; mix = >=2 of these, each independently needed (positives) or each on the harness path (negatives), with the same visibility and introduced value.
conventions.explicit: compile/link failure of the harness, or loud runtime failure on corpus replay with the harness in the top frames / an API-contract message (ASan, LeakSanitizer, assertion)
conventions.silent: builds and runs; gap lines/branches have zero coverage in all 3 seeds without the fix and non-zero in >= 2 seeds with the fix (maintainer fix H or counterfactual Δh)
conventions.negative: builds before and after, no new crash on corpus replay, changed lines covered (> 0) by the fixed corpus; silent negatives must additionally be covered in >= 2 of 3 fuzz seeds
conventions.introduced_vs_preexisting: introduced: gap absent or reachable at M^1; preexisting: the fix applied to M^1 lifts the same gap (verified by a second campaign at M^1) or the harness already failed at M^1
conventions.corpus: fixed corpus decided at M^1: the project/OSS-Fuzz seed corpus at M^1 when it has >= 5 inputs, otherwise that plus 300 s of libFuzzer on the M^1 build
conventions.gt_source: maintainer_fix / coupled_commit / counterfactual_fix for positives; negatives use "experiment" (the verdict of the negative experiment)
conventions.change_origin: real_commit = M is a mainline commit used as-is; real_commit_lib_hunks_only = R2 split of a coupled commit (library hunks only, harness at M^1); report metrics separately

deviations_from_plan: fuzz budget B reduced to 3 seeds x 600 s (plan: 3 x 3600 s); exec threshold scaled to 166,666 execs per seed; recorded per sample
single 2-core machine: no R3 HEAD audit over the whole OSS-Fuzz pool; R3-style gaps were found by targeted audits of selected harnesses
Δh counterfactual fixes were NOT submitted upstream (user decision); they ship in verification/counterfactual_fix.diff

custom build recipes where the date-pinned OSS-Fuzz build.sh could not run offline: expat (protobuf LPM fuzzer), pcre2 (8-bit target only), xz (CMake instead of autotools/autopoint), fmt (no OSS-Fuzz project before 2020-10), mbedtls (generated sources via `make generated_files`, which the 2021 OSS-Fuzz build.sh lacked; the openssl/boringssl corpora cloned by the Dockerfile are replaced by the project's own tests/data_files DER/PEM/key files); recipes ship in input/harness/build/

zstd V3-15 and pugixml V3-38 pin the first OSS-Fuzz project revision (zstd eebdc80cb 2017-09-29, pugixml 19a52805b6 2020-09-09; both within days of M) for every build, because no earlier revision exists for M^1

libpng V3-17: the maintainer fix f648294931 is applied as its own one-line hunk ported onto the harness at M (verification/counterfactual_fix.diff), because the harness at H also carries unrelated additions
extra repositories cloned by Dockerfiles (google/fuzzing, yaml-cpp-fuzzer, zlib for libspng) are taken at their current HEAD, not date-pinned
V3-47 and V3-48 are imported from MiniDataset-v5 (see imported_samples); their evidence was produced with OSS-Fuzz base-builder images and unmodified build.sh, not with this repository's toolchain

libspng V3-44 (2019, meson era): meson is not available offline, so build.sh's meson/ninja step is replaced by compiling the meson library target directly with its default options (optimize_defilter=true) and -fcommon (pre-clang-11 default needed by the tentative definitions in common.h); recorded in collection_tools/tools/projects.json build_sed

nlohmann-json V3-46: the replay corpus is the 300 s M^1 fuzz corpus plus one documented trigger input (CBOR half-precision NaN, stored in verification/trigger_inputs/); 4 of the 5 failing inputs at M come from the fuzz corpus itself
V3-46 and V3-17 apply the maintainer's fix hunk ported onto the harness at M (prefer_delta_h), because the harness at H also contains unrelated later changes
unbound V3-08: util/configlexer.lex needs flex, which is not installed; flex 2.6.4 was built locally from the official release tarball for this sample (see label.evidence)

flac V3-13: experiments were run with gcc 15.2.0 and cmake 4.2.3 (Debug, no sanitizers) on WSL Ubuntu 26.04, not with the clang 18.1.3 toolchain; the verdict is an assertion failure on a two-call replay and does not depend on sanitizers
toolchain: native v3 samples: clang/LLVM 18.1.3 + self-built compiler-rt llvmorg-18.1.3 (see collection_tools); samples imported from MiniDataset-v5: OSS-Fuzz base-builder:latest, unmodified build.sh (see each sample verification/NOTES.txt)
evaluation_packaging: give a model only <sample>/input/ and <sample>/case.json; never the directory path, label.json, meta.json, NOTES.md or verification/
